# MOBAflow Copilot instructions

Read and follow the repository's [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It is the shared source for agent workflow,
architecture constraints, build commands and validation. Do not maintain a duplicate rule set here.

Use the [instruction index](instructions/instructions-index.md) to load technical guidance relevant to the files
being changed. Path-specific instructions supplement AGENTS.md; historical notes and optional tooling are not
additional workflow or approval requirements.
